Please feel free to contact us for additional photos or for information at:

info@pewterandwoodantiques.com
or call 602-677-5686

All items are sold with a full satisfaction guarantee and a 48 hour right to return. See Terms Of Sale below. Shop hours in both locations are by appointment or by chance. Please call for directions.

Pewter & Wood Antiques – Enfield, NH

During summer and fall (May – October), we are just off Route 4A on Crystal Lake in Enfield, New Hampshire.

(603) 632-9822 – shop
(602) 677-5686 – cell

Pewter & Wood Antiques – Cave Creek, AZ

In winter and spring, (November – May), we are just over a mile north of the center of Cave Creek, Arizona (35 minutes north of the Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport).

(602) 677-5686 – cell

Terms of Sale

We accept checks and money orders. Items will be shipped promptly upon receiving payment and check clearance. We ship via Fed Ex, UPS and Priority Mail. All items will be insured for their value. Arrangements for shipping furniture can be made with a mutually agreed upon carrier. All shipping and insurance  costs are paid by the buyer.

Refunds are in full, minus outbound shipping and insurance. Returns are at buyer’s expense: shipping and insurance. Also items must be in the same condition as when sold. Refunds will be sent upon receipt of item and inspection.

Should an item arrive damaged, contact us immediately by e-mail at info@pewterandwoodantiques.com.

content.rendered:
I grew up in Connecticut where my parents introduced me to collecting antiques as a child. We spent many weekends traveling the backroads searching for antiques. In 1970 I moved to Vermont to go to college and I became very interested in country furniture and accessories. Weekends while teaching, I was drawn to country auctions.

After moving to Arizona in 1982, I opened an antique shop in part of my house and began exhibiting at shows around the southwest. Traveling back to New England several times a year, I brought truckloads of country pieces to Arizona. In 1991, Pewter & Wood opened in Scottsdale, AZ.

Locations in Arizona and New Hampshire

In 2001, Pewter & Wood opened a second location in Enfield, New Hampshire. In 2004, the Scottsdale shop moved to Cave Creek, AZ.

Both shops are stocked with 18th and 19th c. American antiques, with emphasis on original, first surface paint. Pewter & Wood continues to exhibit at shows on the East Coast. We would love to share the desert with you November through April in Cave Creek, Arizona. From May through October please visit us on Crystal Lake, in Enfield, New Hampshire. Contact us for directions.

Barbara Boardman Johnson
Pewter & Wood Antiques

Member of:

New Hampshire Antique Dealers Association

Vermont Antique Dealers Association

content.rendered:
We specialize in 18th and 19th C. American Antiques with emphasis on original first surface paint. Country furniture, painted smalls, folk art, textiles, hooked rugs, braided rugs, samplers, stoneware, toys, game boards, signs, pewter and decorative accessories are among the items that we love. Inventory is constantly changing. We hope you visit our site often.

We are located in both Enfield, New Hampshire and Cave Creek, Arizona. The New Hampshire shop is open May – October and Arizona is open November – April. Both are by chance or appointment. When traveling, feel free to give us a call. We will gladly open for you.

 

Please check back soon as we are in the process of updating
our website and we will be adding more items for sale.
